title: Add to_html_list and to_html_badge generators to Rust string-utils library
description: A Rust string-utils library gets two simple HTML-generation helpers for rendering word lists and count badges.

task_spec.prompt:
The Rust library in src/lib.rs has word_count and capitalize_words. Add two HTML-generation functions: 1. pub fn to_html_list(words: &[&str]) -> String Returns an HTML
    with one
  • per word. Empty slice returns
      . 2. pub fn to_html_badge(label: &str, count: usize) -> String Returns {label}{count} Write 2 tests for each function (4 total): test_html_list_items — to_html_list(&["alpha", "beta"]) contains
    • alpha
      • and
    • beta
      • test_html_list_empty — to_html_list(&[]) == "
        " test_html_badge_basic — to_html_badge("words", 3) contains class="badge" and contains "words" and "3" test_html_badge_zero — to_html_badge("items", 0) contains "0" All 3 original tests must still pass. cargo test must pass all 7 tests. cargo build must succeed.
required_artifacts: pub fn to_html_badge(label: &str, count: usize) -> String
success_criteria: HTML output contains correct tags and data
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `cargo test` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
